rules.call: unit=call: each call costs price, however many items come back.
rules.item: unit=item: price times the items returned, at least one item, at most max_charge per call.
rules.failures: Failed and timed-out calls are never charged.
rules.idempotency: Resending with the same Idempotency-Key within 24 hours replays the stored result at no charge.
rules.paging: Each page is its own call and its own charge.
